description: Windows SKK-style Japanese IME with a CPU zenz inference server
pre_install: if ($global) { abort 'Use a per-user Scoop installation; nskkzime manages the machine-wide IME registration for one managing user.' }
notes: Use a non-packaged PowerShell launched directly from Explorer or the Start menu. IME registration requires UAC approval by the same user. Native Windows x64 only; global Scoop installs are unsupported.
Configure a separate SKK dictionary and zenz model from nskkzime Settings. Inference requires AVX2/FMA/F16C/BMI2 support.
Close applications before updating. Restart them or sign out and back in to use the new DLL.
Uninstall unregisters the IME and broker startup, retaining protected program files in %ProgramFiles%\nskkzime and user data in %LOCALAPPDATA%\nskkzime.
See https://github.com/nekomimist/nskkzime/blob/main/docs/PACKAGE_README.md#完全削除 for complete removal.
